title: Ana Mazloom Hussain
body:
Ana Mazloom Hussain
<<MINI>>
Ana Mazloom Hussain Ana Mahroom Hussain
Main Hoon Mazloom Hussain Mein Hoon Mahroom Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
1) Barsare Dashte bala Jaane zehra ne kaha
Shimr Khanjar na chala khushk hai mera gala
Margaye Mere Jawaan Lutgaya mera jahan ×2
Dekh Baali pay meri Syeda karti hai bain
<<DIVIDER>>
2) Mein Hu farzand e Nabi Gulshan E Haq ki kali
Jaan e zehra o Ali Hoon Ali ibne wali
Kya nahi tujhko Qabar Shimr Allah se dar ×2
Dekh ye zulm na kar Mai hoon Islam ke Zaain.
<<DIVIDER>>
3)Mera Lashkar na raha Mera Akbar na Raha
Mera Asghar Na raha koi Yaawar Na raha
Mera Nasir hai khuda Mera sar kar na Judaa ×2
Arsh par Mere liye hai bapa Shewan O Shaen
<<DIVIDER>>
4) Shimr Shaitaan hai tu Shimr Haiwaan hai tu
Nange adiyaan hai tu jehl ki jaan hai tu
Dushman e Deen E khuda Dushman e Rabe ullah x2
Behaya tu bhai bada mein hu Imaan ki zaen
<<DIVIDER>>
5) Shimr Be deen bataa maine kya ki hai qataa
Jiski deta hai sazaa tu hai malo'on bada
Mai Hu Mazloom bohot Mai hu Maghmoom Bohat x2
Dekh is waqt zaraa Ambiya karte hai baen
<<DIVIDER>>
6) Aai khaaliq ki sada aye Shahe Karbobala
Sar ko sajde mein jhuka sabr ki hadd to dikha
Sun ke khaaliq ki Sada Jaane zehra ne kaha x2
Teri aawaz suni agaya qalb ko chaen
<<DIVIDER>>
7) Khanjar E shimr Chala katgaya shai ka galaa
Hogaya Hashr bapa Khoon e Shabbir Baha
Durr Sakina ke chine Qaid Sajjad Hue X2
Dekhiye Sabr e Hussain faatah e Badr o Hunain
<<DIVIDER>>
8) Aye Mere rab e Ulaa mujh ko Qayam se mila
Jaa'n karu un pay fida aur shahadat ho aata
Hai Riyaz ab ye dua Jaye hum karbobala X2
Raoza e shaah pe hum yu'n kare shewano Shain
<<MINI>>
Ana Mazloom Hussain Ana Mahroom Hussain
Mai hu Mazloom Hussain Mai hu Mahroom Hussain
